import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong features by t-statistic threshold
    strong_idx = np.where(np.abs(feats.x.mean(axis=0)) > 0.5)[0]
    if len(strong_idx) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster correlated features
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, strong_idx].T)
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, 
                                         distance_threshold=0.6,
                                         linkage='average')
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(corr_matrix)
    
    # Select representative features from each cluster
    selected_features = []
    for i in range(clusters.max() + 1):
        cluster_features = [feats.ids[strong_idx[j]] for j in np.where(clusters == i)[0]]
        # Pick feature with highest absolute mean difference
        best_feature = max(cluster_features, key=lambda fid: abs(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean()))
        selected_features.append(best_feature)
    
    # Sort by effect size (mean_y1 - mean_y0)
    selected_features.sort(key=lambda fid: abs(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean()), reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features as drivers
    drivers = tuple(selected_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Build columns and products
    columns = tuple(selected_features[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    products = ()
    loadings = {fid: feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean() for fid in columns}
